authorization.scope: Delegate D01-D06 technical choices; preserve original T00-A real-world validation gate and no merge / no T00-B instructions.

D01.choice: Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript GUI; Rust engine/common commands; SQLite local storage; FFmpeg/ffprobe subprocess; stdio MCP with tested 2025-11-25 baseline
D01.basis: Exact Windows CI SHA 828e745 core/lifecycle/GUI 33 checks; no demonstrated reason to replace stack. Electron/.NET not benchmarked.
D01.validation_remaining: User Windows 11 x64 GUI and audible synthetic WAV; supported MCP client interoperability later T04.

D02.choice: Initial product/validation target Windows 11 x64. Windows 10, ARM64 and x86 are outside initial support claim.
D02.basis: Narrow first supported target and validate before expansion. Current Server 2022 x64 CI is not Windows 11 user proof.
D02.validation_remaining: Windows 11 non-admin interactive run, exact OS build, WebView2 prerequisite; T06 packaging acceptance.

D03.choice: Initial portable ZIP. WebView2 prerequisite external; FFmpeg/ffprobe user-configured location or PATH, no bundled or automatic installation.
D03.basis: Keeps runtime redistribution/licensing outside unverified assumptions and fits existing executable spike. Spike ZIP is not a product release.
D03.validation_remaining: T06 packaging/update/data-preservation and notices; installer/signing/public distribution not authorized.

D04.choice: App configuration/engine discovery under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DK-Elevenlabs-GameSound-Manager. User explicitly selects local workspace directory. Originals copied into managed storage; source and approved versions immutable.
D04.basis: Tested separation, Unicode/space paths and synthetic original hash preservation. No program-folder data storage.
D04.validation_remaining: T01 schema/import/reconciliation and actual paths; network/sync storage not initially supported.

D05.choice: Windows Credential Manager, current user. No silent DPAPI fallback; credential failure leaves offline features usable and remote generation disabled. Product credential implementation at T02.
D05.basis: Dummy write/read/delete passed; reduces application-owned ciphertext file lifecycle. No actual key validated.
D05.validation_remaining: T02 actual authorized key, lifecycle/export/log boundaries; no keys or credits now.

choice.ownership: One engine per Windows user SID across project workspaces; user-scoped discovery/startup lock, single writer.
choice.ipc: Local Windows named pipe with owner SID DACL and remote-client rejection. No product loopback TCP/token or workspace-local engine default.
choice.startup: GUI/CLI/MCP auto-start on first use; no Windows service or login-start requirement.
choice.gui_close: Disconnect only; queued/running work continues and reconnects.
choice.normal_shutdown: Reject while queued/running work exists; do not silently cancel. No forced-stop product API in T00-B.
choice.idle_shutdown: Exit after 300000ms continuously with zero connected clients AND no queued/running work. New client resets timer; busy engine never idles out.
choice.recovery: Do not automatically replay interrupted or uncertain work. Account-wide budget ownership belongs to T02; file/DB reconciliation later tasks.

D06.basis: Single writer/lifetime spike and standalone distinct-user pipe DACL support the architecture; 5-minute product idle is a delegated design choice, not measured optimum or reused 3-second fixture.
D06.validation_remaining: Product named-pipe integration, remote rejection, SID-level startup races/multiple workspaces, client lifecycle and idle policy at T00-B after current gate; account budget T02.

prohibitions_retained: No real game or sound changes
Do not call CI media events human listening
